description: Terminal-Bench style regression hunt: restore the packed git history from a bundle, then bisect the deterministic operation-count benchmark to the first bad commit and write commit=<sha> plus a reason line. Needs git on PATH.

criteria: The report names exactly the commit that switched lookup from the dict index to a linear scan (the first commit where the operation-count benchmark fails) with a reason line, found via git bisect or history analysis, with the repo left on main at HEAD and no history rewrite.
